title: Graph State Persistence
summary: This module defines abstract and concrete implementations for persisting the state of graph runs. It allows saving and loading graph execution progress, enabling features like resuming runs or inspecting historical states.

nodes.label: Define Persistence Interface
nodes.title: Base State Persistence
nodes.description: Abstract base class defining the interface for storing and retrieving the state of a graph run, including node snapshots and end states.

nodes.label: Persist State to File
nodes.title: File State Persistence
nodes.description: Concrete implementation of state persistence that stores graph run snapshots as JSON data in a specified file, handling atomic updates and locking.

nodes.label: Persist State In-Memory
nodes.title: Full State Persistence
nodes.description: Concrete implementation of state persistence that stores graph run snapshots in memory, optionally performing deep copies of state and nodes.

nodes.label: Execute Graph
nodes.title: Graph Execution Engine
nodes.description: The core graph execution engine that utilizes a persistence mechanism to manage and restore its state during runs, especially for iterative or resumable processes.

nodes.label: Node State Snapshot
nodes.title: Node Snapshot
nodes.description: A data structure representing the state of the graph at a specific node, including the graph's overall state and the next node to be executed.

nodes.label: Graph End Snapshot
nodes.title: End Snapshot
nodes.description: A data structure representing the final state of the graph run, including the overall graph state and the result of the run.

groups.label: Persistence Interface
groups.title: Persistence Interface Definition
groups.description: Defines the abstract contract for how graph run states are stored and retrieved.

groups.label: File-based Persistence
groups.title: File-based State Storage
groups.description: Provides concrete implementation for persisting graph states to local JSON files.

groups.label: In-memory Persistence
groups.title: In-memory State Storage
groups.description: Provides concrete implementation for persisting graph states in volatile memory, suitable for short-lived or test runs.

groups.label: Graph Core
groups.title: Graph Execution Core
groups.description: Represents the main graph execution logic that interacts with persistence mechanisms.

groups.label: Snapshot Data
groups.title: Graph State Snapshots
groups.description: Data structures used to capture and represent the state of a graph at various points during its execution.
